# TemporalErrorPropagation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The mechanism by which conversion errors in early time steps propagate and compound through recurrent spiking dynamics, destabilizing closed-loop control. Motivates the development of error-correction mechanisms or hybrid ANN-SNN architectures in iNEST for stable long-horizon operation.
